feature: Sign in and reach the application
title: Valid sign-in reaches the VPP dashboard
preconditions: The configured APP_URL is reachable and the test account can sign in. Use only https://qa-test-flexkiosk.ks.autogridsystems.net and QA-only data. Store credentials in environment configuration, not in specs, reports, screenshots, or TestRail case text.
steps:
1. Navigate to APP_URL.
2. Sign in with the configured QA account.
expected_results:
1. The FlexPlus sign-in page is displayed with Username, Password, and Log in controls.
2. Authentication succeeds and the VPP dashboard loads.
roles: Configured QA account (documented role details: unknown)
notes: Exact dashboard URL, heading, or welcome element after successful sign-in: unknown (not specified in the document).

feature: Sign in and reach the application
title: Wrong password is denied and no authenticated view is exposed (user stays on sign-in page)
preconditions: The configured APP_URL is reachable. The document specifies this is attempted in a later isolated test. Do not record credentials in test artifacts.
steps:
1. Navigate to APP_URL.
2. Attempt sign-in with invalid credentials (incorrect password).
expected_results:
1. The FlexPlus sign-in page is displayed with Username, Password, and Log in controls.
2. Access is denied with an actionable validation or authentication error; no authenticated view is exposed (the user remains on the sign-in page).
validations: An actionable validation or authentication error is shown; exact error message text: unknown.
notes: The document groups invalid and missing credentials under one step: 'Attempt invalid or missing credentials in a later isolated test.' Specific wrong-password error wording and any lockout behavior: unknown.

feature: Sign in and reach the application
title: Empty/missing credentials are denied and no authenticated view is exposed (user stays on sign-in page)
preconditions: The configured APP_URL is reachable. The document specifies this is attempted in a later isolated test. Do not record credentials in test artifacts.
steps:
1. Navigate to APP_URL.
2. Attempt sign-in with missing credentials (empty Username and/or Password).
expected_results:
1. The FlexPlus sign-in page is displayed with Username, Password, and Log in controls.
2. Access is denied with an actionable validation or authentication error; no authenticated view is exposed (the user remains on the sign-in page).
validations: An actionable validation or authentication error is shown; exact required-field message text and whether the Log in control is disabled: unknown.
notes: The document groups invalid and missing credentials under one step: 'Attempt invalid or missing credentials in a later isolated test.' Behavior differences between empty username, empty password, or both empty: unknown.
